response.sql:
WITH item_quantities AS (
  SELECT order_id, CAST(product_quantity AS REAL) AS quantity
  FROM Order_Items
),
order_averages AS (
  SELECT order_id, AVG(quantity) AS average_quantity
  FROM item_quantities
  GROUP BY order_id
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(quantity) AS baseline_quantity
  FROM item_quantities
)
SELECT oa.order_id,
       oa.average_quantity,
       oa.average_quantity - b.baseline_quantity AS difference
FROM order_averages AS oa
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE b.baseline_quantity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity is intended to be numeric despite being stored as VARCHAR; the query casts it to REAL, and nonnumeric values are treated as missing by SQLite.
